title: Recruitee Jobs API input
description: Give one or more Recruitee board slugs.

boards.title: Boards
boards.description: Recruitee boards to read, one per item: a slug like bunq, a host like bunq.recruitee.com or a URL like https://bunq.recruitee.com/. A company that does not exist answers 404 and gets a free NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND row instead of a silent empty run.

includeDetails.title: Include descriptions
includeDetails.description: Include the full description and requirements of every offer. On by default: on a live board that is 715 KB of text for 124 offers.

descriptionFormat.title: Description format
descriptionFormat.description: HTML keeps the employer markup, text strips the tags and keeps the line breaks.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Max offers per board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: How many matching offers to process per board. 0 means no limit. Offers past the limit are counted, never charged.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma separated phrases; an offer matches when any phrase occurs in its title, department, category or tags. Example: engineer, data. Empty means no keyword filter.

department.title: Department contains
department.description: Keep only offers whose department contains this text.

employmentType.title: Employment type contains
employmentType.description: Keep only offers whose employment type code contains this text, for example fulltime.

experience.title: Experience contains
experience.description: Keep only offers whose experience code contains this text, for example senior.

category.title: Category contains
category.description: Keep only offers whose category code contains this text, for example banking.

city.title: Office city contains
city.description: Keep only offers with an office whose city contains this text. Every office of an offer is checked, not only the first one.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only offers the employer marked as remote. Hybrid offers are not remote.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Keep only offers published after this moment, as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty means no date filter.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for one board answer. A big board arrives as one 1.9 MB answer, so do not set this too low.
